description: Grade several claims of one list verification again, each as lists.verifications.claim-rechecks.create does: against the verified list's facts as they stand now (held facts are left out) and the facts linked to it, recording the new grade in the claim's history and withdrawing its earlier status, override, reopening and record-conflict resolution. Use it for the claims lists.verifications.get reports as out of date (`staleness`). Returns one result per claim: `rechecked` (with `replayed: true` when its `requestKey` already graded it), or `refused` with the error that claim alone would get. When every claim is refused for the same reason (an organization at its verification limit is refused before any claim is graded), the request fails with that error.

requestKey.description: A key you choose for this claim's re-check. Sending the same key for the claim again grades nothing twice: its result says replayed true.
